# The target table has 993 tuples, so no further aggregation or filtering is needed.
# Just ensure the column name and type matches the target schema.

# Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_47/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
